title: Lawful signing and verification
acceptance_scenarios: For the selected lawful method, test signer attribution and confirmation. Where CA signing applies, verify outside the app, preserve signed bytes and signing-time certificate/status evidence, and test tampering/revocation handling.
evidence_after_implementation: A08-signed-synthetic-sample.pdf; detached signature/container if used; certificate-chain-and-status evidence; independent-verification.pdf; provider/method assessment.
manual_acceptance: Legal/clinical owner selects the lawful method by document. No personal signing key enters the pack. Refresh on provider, signing component, standards or method changes; retain long-term verification material.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
external_dependencies: Authority specifications/onboarding and provider credentials have not been arranged; no live submission or CA certification claim.
implemented_controls: Internal clinician confirmation identifies the authenticated signer and preserves the content seal. Consent evidence PDF distinguishes drawn signatures from certified digital signatures. Integration readiness stores provider/specification/onboarding references.
remaining_actions: Select accredited CA/equivalent lawful mechanism, obtain approved signing profile, implement its driver and validate certificates/timestamps/revocation before a certified-signing claim.
